messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.z@vitalityhealth.com>, Michael Rivera <michael.rivera@vitalityhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Post-call: security scope + IAM evidence needed to progress (Vitality Health)

Hi Emily + Michael —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned on what Redwood needs to unblock procurement and the security review:

- Compliance posture: please confirm current SOC 2 status (Type I/II, report date) and whether you’d like a copy of Redwood’s SOC 2 interim report. Also confirm GDPR data residency preferences and whether HIPAA applies to the workloads we discussed.
- IAM evidence: we need SAML metadata (or IdP export), SCIM provisioning endpoint (and test credentials), and a current admin roster with RBAC assignments (CSV is fine: name, email, role).
- Vendor questionnaire: I’ve attached a short vendor security questionnaire (vitality-security-questionnaire.pdf). If you can complete the highlighted sections, we’ll intake and return any follow-ups within 48 business hours.
- Timing: if we receive the SAML metadata + admin roster by EOD next Wed (2026-11-09), Redwood can provide the SCIM connector template and a sample RBAC policy by the following week.

Attachments: vitality-security-questionnaire.pdf (fill), redwood-sso-sample-metadata.xml (sample), iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx (checklist/format for admin roster)

Proposed owners:
- Emily: SAML metadata, HIPAA/GDPR confirmation
- Michael: internal admin roster + any legal procurement contacts
- Redwood (Ben): SCIM connector template and SCIM test harness
- Redwood (Monica): BAA & contractual language for HIPAA if applicable

If that timeline works, I’ll follow up with the questionnaire link and set up a 30-min technical session with Ben to walk through SCIM and SAML. Happy to adjust cadence.

Cheers,

Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Post-call: security scope + IAM evidence needed to progress (Vitality Health)

Thanks Alex — great summary.

A few clarifications from our side:
- SOC 2: We do not currently have a Type II; we completed a Type I in 2025 and plan to start Type II in Q1 2027. Would Redwood accept a Type I plus your SOC 2 interim report for now?
- HIPAA: Yes, parts of the pilot will handle PHI. We will require a BAA for production; for early-stage pilots, we can proceed under a temp agreement but need your security posture documented.
- Admin roster: we can provide a CSV but can you share the expected column headers (email, role, entitlement list)?

We’ll start filling the questionnaire and aim to return the highlighted sections within 3 business days. I’ll loop our security lead (security@vitalityhealth.com) if we have follow-ups.

On the SAML metadata: I can export the metadata but need to confirm which attributes you require (name, email, role, employee_id?). Please advise.

Best,

Emily Zhang
Director, IT Security
Vitality Health
emily.z@vitalityhealth.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.z@vitalityhealth.com>, Michael Rivera <michael.rivera@vitalityhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security scope + IAM evidence needed to progress (Vitality Health)

Emily — thanks for the quick response.

Short answers:
- SOC 2: Type I + Redwood’s SOC 2 interim report is acceptable to proceed for pilot/procurement. We’ll provide our latest report and an outline of controls that map to the questionnaire.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood offers BAAs for Private deployments and for Dedicated customers. Monica will draft a BAA template and flag any production gating criteria.
- Admin roster format: see attached iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx — expected columns: full_name, email, manager_email, role_label, entitlements (comma-separated), employee_id (optional). CSV derived from that sheet is fine.
- SAML attributes: email (required), given_name, family_name, and a role attribute if possible. We can map role_label on our side to RBAC roles; role attribute eases provisioning.

Attachments included (stubs): redwood-sso-sample-metadata.xml, iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-security-pack-vitality

Next steps I’ll take now:
1) Ben will prepare a SCIM connector template and a short demo for your team (requesting test creds when you have them).
2) Monica will draft a BAA and call out any data residency options relevant to GDPR.
3) I’ll review the questionnaire once you return it and flag gaps.

If you can send the SAML metadata and a small test admin CSV by EOD next Wed (2026-11-09) we’ll aim to have the SCIM template and RBAC sample policy ready by 2026-11-16.

Thanks — speak soon.

Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sso-sample-metadata.xml (sample metadata), iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx (admin roster template)

Ben/Monica — internal follow-up after Emily’s reply.

Quick assignment:
- Ben: start the SCIM connector template using our connector pattern for Okta/OneLogin. Aim for a draft by 2026-11-11. Include test harness instructions and a sample SCIM token rotation note.
- Monica: BAA draft + HIPAA gating notes. Also call out what flags in the questionnaire would require Legal escalation. Draft due 2026-11-10.
- I’ll own questionnaire review and coordinate the technical call. Please cc me on any questions for Emily.

Keep thread updates short; we’ll sync at the weekly sales-engineering standup if needed.

Alex
